title: Python requirement declared only by exclusion
description: requirements.txt declares a requirement that names only a version to exclude. Every other release satisfies the line, including every future one, so the requirement is effectively unbounded.
remediation: Add an upper bound or pin the exact version under test.
limitation: It matches a requirement that names only a version to exclude in the parsed requirements.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
